name: Capital Velocity / Time Stop
known_limitations: Lite has no holding-history/ATR gate runtime.
notes: Legacy six-gates-production-v1 is selected active V1; this Lite artifact is review-required knowledge only. Unresolved velocity config or missing holding entry date/ATR expansion => INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

details.purpose: Identify inactive existing holdings for rotation review.

pass_condition.description: Outside existing-holding management contexts: not applicable PASS for this gate. Otherwise fewer than 12 trading sessions elapsed or ATR expansion >= 1.0.

fail_condition.description: Existing holding aged >= 12 trading sessions with ATR expansion < 1.0; separate rotation comparison adjustment -0.50 is recorded without altering raw score.

details.score_interaction: Separate -0.50 comparison/rotation adjustment only; raw Decision Score remains unchanged and neither score nor LLM rescues FAIL.
details.strategy_interaction: Does not create a sell or rotation strategy.
details.portfolio_context: Requires existing holding history and exchange calendar.
known_limitations: Lite has no holding-history/ATR gate runtime.
